newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Great Eastern Life opens Shanghai office.
newsitem.headline: Great Eastern Life opens Shanghai office.

text.p: Great Eastern Life said on Thursday it set up an office in Shanghai due to rising demand for insurance protection in China resulting from strong economic growth and social reform.

The representative office in Shanghai, its first in China, will conduct research, support the development of life insurance in China and transfer technical and professional knowledge to local insurance personnel.
"This represents another significant step towards strengthening our presence in the region," said Tan Beng Lee, chief executive officer of Great Eastern Life.
He said the financial and business centre of Shanghai, with a population of 13.7 million people presented tremendous opportunities for business growth.
In 1994, insurance premiums for life and general business in Shanghai alone totalled Singapore $354 million.
